verdict.rationale: Insomnia documents natural-language input for one task: generating a mock server from a prompt plus a URL, OpenAPI, or JSON input, with routes and responses scaffolded automatically. AI commit message suggestions are assistive output, not natural-language commands, and there is no evidence of a general assistant for sending requests, building collections, running tests, or managing environments. Missing for 10: general natural-language control of core features (requests, collections, tests, environments), a conversational command interface, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
